purpose: Compare caller-supplied ordered feature positions with one linear or circular repetition rule in millimetres.
trigger: Use when the live root, positions, rule, and tolerance are supplied; do not infer CAD feature locations.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Live current document root Part used only to assert active-root context; no CAD feature is read.

inputs.name: feature_positions_mm
inputs.description: At least two ordered, caller-supplied feature positions in millimetres; no feature identity or CAD geometry is resolved.

inputs.name: expected_rule
inputs.description: One linear/translation or circular/polar rule with rule-specific fields.

preconditions: root is the live current root Part, but the action compares only caller-supplied positions/rule/tolerance.
feature_positions_mm contains at least two finite positions and expected_rule is explicit.

outputs.name: action_id
outputs.description: Literal validation action identity emitted by the script.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Action status from the script result; no status is inferred when execution is unavailable.

outputs.name: geometry_modified
outputs.description: Always false for this read-only action.

outputs.name: gui_interaction
outputs.description: Always false; the action does not drive the GUI.

outputs.name: runtime_claim
outputs.description: Always false; the result does not by itself promote runtime evidence.

outputs.name: validation_boundary
outputs.description: Read-only current-root measurement/check boundary reported by the action.

outputs.name: root_scope
outputs.description: current_root on a completed position/rule comparison.

outputs.name: positions_mm
outputs.description: Normalized caller-supplied positions used on a completed comparison.

outputs.name: rule
outputs.description: Normalized rule on a completed linear/translation or circular/polar comparison.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Per-step errors in millimetres on a completed comparison; circular angular error is converted to chord length.

outputs.name: angular_errors_deg
outputs.description: Per-position angular discrepancies in degrees on a completed circular/polar comparison; empty for a linear/translation rule.

outputs.name: angular_errors_mm
outputs.description: Per-position angular discrepancies converted to chord-length millimetres on a completed circular/polar comparison; empty for a linear/translation rule.

outputs.name: max_error
outputs.description: Maximum comparison error in millimetres on a completed comparison.

outputs.name: tolerance
outputs.description: Applied tolerance in millimetres on a completed comparison.

outputs.name: tolerance_mm
outputs.description: Canonical millimetre alias of the applied tolerance on a completed comparison.

outputs.name: count_matches
outputs.description: Whether optional rule count agrees with len(positions_mm) on a completed comparison.

outputs.name: matches
outputs.description: Whether count and geometric rule errors satisfy tolerance on a completed comparison.

outputs.name: mode
outputs.description: Normalized rule mode echoed on an unsupported-rule manual-review result when available.

outputs.name: needs_manual_review
outputs.description: Present when the supplied positions/rule are insufficient or ambiguous.

outputs.name: reason
outputs.description: Manual-review reason when present.

postconditions: ATOMIC_OUTPUT.errors compares the supplied positions against exactly one rule; circular angular discrepancy is converted to chord-length millimetres before tolerance comparison.
No CAD feature location, body/face measurement, or geometry mutation is performed.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper with ATOMIC_INPUT/ATOMIC_OUTPUT; runtime execution remains not_tested in this candidate.
implementation.notes: Candidate exact artifact is bound below; consult the exact-version evidence layers for tested variants. Adapt guidance feature_positions/expected_repeat_rule/tolerance to ATOMIC_INPUT={root, feature_positions_mm, tolerance_mm, expected_rule}; do not dispatch feature identities or a CAD-derived placement result. The action is pure supplied-position/rule comparison.

ambiguity_checks: Resolve the declared target from its supplied identity and semantic properties; do not use arbitrary BodyN/FaceN aliases or return order.
If the target is not unique or the current topology/view cannot be observed, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; this operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: The declared target, scope, or view identity is missing or ambiguous.
failure_modes.detection: The supplied identity does not resolve to exactly one current target.
failure_modes.safe_state: No validation action is performed and no pass claim is emitted.

failure_modes.condition: The required API, host path, controller gesture, or visible state cannot be observed.
failure_modes.detection: The adapter or controller reports unsupported/blocked/unknown state.
failure_modes.safe_state: Preserve the current document/view and return needs_manual_review or not_tested.

recovery.action: Strengthen the target identity or stop for manual review; do not substitute a numbered alias.
Use only a verified equivalent control/API or return needs_manual_review; do not repeat an unsupported gesture.
